cards.text: Moses, Israel's leader, calls together the heads of the tribes of Israel because he has a command to pass on. Friend, when the heads of EVERY tribe get called in at once, that's the "everybody put your phone down" meeting.

cards.question: Moses tells the heads of the tribes of Israel that this command comes from whom?
When a man makes a vow to the LORD or swears an oath, what does the command say he must do?

answers.text: Pay a fine if he backs out

cards.text: Then the command walks through vows made by a young woman in her father's house, a woman who marries while under a vow, and a wife in her husband's house. If her father or husband hears of the vow and says nothing, it stands, but if he prohibits her when he hears of it, it doesn't, and the LORD will absolve her. Every vow a widow or divorced woman pledges is binding on her, and a husband who nullifies his wife's vows after he hears of them will bear her iniquity. These are the statutes the LORD commanded Moses about a man and his wife, and a father and a young daughter still in his home.
